question: Will more patrols stop the attacks, yes or no?
hook_lines: NATO SENDS PLANES TO BLACK SEA

lines.text: NATO is sending more patrol planes, drones and radar to the Black Sea.
It follows deadly drone strikes on merchant ships.
NATO's North Atlantic Council discussed Black Sea security in Brussels on Tuesday.
Last week, drones struck two chemical tankers off Romania's coast and set them ablaze.
At least five other cargo ships were hit near Romania and Bulgaria in the 10 days before.
In all, Reuters says at least 23 sailors are missing or dead.
NATO has not said who carried out the attacks.
Military analysts say Russia almost certainly did. Moscow has not acknowledged responsibility.
Colonel Martin O'Donnell says allies are sending teams to test the explosives.
Spokesperson Allison Hart says NATO has already strengthened its eastern flank, including counter-drone capabilities.
Her words: we will continue to stand united and ensure that we are ready and able to address any threat.

scene.quote: We will continue to stand united and ensure that we are ready and able to address any threat

lines.text: Romania and Bulgaria, both NATO members, line the western Black Sea.
Will more patrols stop the attacks, yes or no?
